label: Hollow Pines
summary: A mountain town cut off by the first snow of winter, where the radio picks up voices it shouldn't.

world.setting: Hollow Pines, a logging town high in the mountains, snowed in until spring
world.description: One road in, closed by snow. A diner, a sheriff's office, a radio station in an old fire lookout, and a forest that is quieter than a forest should be.
rules: Horror builds slowly: dread first, answers late
Something supernatural is real here, and it is never fully explained
People can be hurt, and choices have consequences

narration.tone: Quiet, creeping dread with moments of warmth
